name: Overpass
invitation: A low passage runs under a broad roof, with a wall beyond. Decide which side of the roof your line belongs on, then try to bring it somewhere else. The structure stays fixed; origin, aim and power are yours.
physicalQuestion: Can one piece of architecture support a lower return and an upper carry, with understandable changes between them?
nearbySensitivity: All eight immediate neighbours (yaw and elevation plus or minus 0.5 degrees, power plus or minus 0.01, and origin plus or minus 0.5 m) preserve each of the upper-carry and lower-return families. Three power detents above upper-carry miss the roof and meet the wall. The underside contact is physically real but fragile: one elevation detent makes a front-edge strike.
validationEvidence: Actual Havok through the shared Worldcraft runtime at 120 Hz, seven manifest shots and sixteen immediate neighbours; a no-deck control, exact repeats and Scene-observable stepping; eight repeated load-fire-reset-switch cycles. NullEngine scene resource counts include height guides. No rendered WebGL, phone frame timing, or enjoyment claim.

limitations.concept: A roof with a playable top and a usable lower passage.
limitations.missing: A 16 by 8 m roof needs eight plates, each with a contact seam and required voice. The same scene is not a general terrain system.
limitations.extension: Consider a bounded slab only if independently authored worlds repeatedly need a contiguous deck; no new prefab is necessary for this study.

limitations.concept: The player should distinguish top carry, lower passage and front-edge strike.
limitations.missing: WebGL was unavailable in this session, so a clear side result frame is implemented but visual legibility on desktop and phone is not established.
limitations.extension: Owner test the survey orbit, first contact and return path before promoting this as a general authoring capability.

limitations.concept: Height is already expressible in validated data.
limitations.missing: Lift and tilt are data fields rather than ordinary Build controls. Raising every editor variable would add burden.
limitations.extension: Prefer a height-aware author preview and validation over unrestricted scaling or terrain sculpting.
